phase.preparing.description: Home: the Start recording button while the recording is being prepared.

phase.countdown.description: Home: the Start recording button during the countdown.

phase.recording.description: Home: the Start recording button while recording.

windowHint.full.description: Home: Windows tab: what a window recording gets on this PC.

windowHint.effects.description: Home: Windows tab: what a window recording gets when native window capture is missing.

windowHint.moving.description: Home: Windows tab: after what a window recording gets.

windowHint.none.description: Home: Windows tab: window recordings get no effects on this PC; <link> is a button that switches to the Area tab.

date.today.description: Home: a recording made today; {time} is a time ("14:32").

date.yesterday.description: Home: a recording made yesterday; {time} is a time.

showInExplorer.description: Home: tooltip of the folder button of a recording (opens it in Windows File Explorer).

showNameInExplorer.description: Home: accessible name of a recording’s folder button; {name} is the project’s name.

privacySettings.description: Home: opens the Windows privacy setting that lets Flown use the microphone or camera.

warn.micMissing.description: Home: notice when a recording starts without its microphone.

warn.cameraMissing.description: Home: notice when a recording starts without its camera.

recovering.description: Home: shown while an unfinished recording is turned into a project.

unfinished.deleteQuestion.description: Home: the question before an unfinished recording is deleted; {size} is its size ("1.5 GB").

savingRecording.description: Home: shown while a finished recording is saved.

target.areaOn.description: Home: New recording: the area picked and its screen; {width} and {height} are pixels.

target.area.description: Home: the size of the area picked, in pixels.

target.pickArea.description: Home: New recording: no area picked yet.

target.pickWindow.description: Home: New recording: no window picked yet.

target.noScreen.description: Home: New recording: no screen to record.

sources.title.description: Home: the heading of the sources (screens, windows, an area).

sources.areaHint.description: Home: Area tab: how to pick an area.

tab.screens.description: Home: the tab of screens to record.

tab.windows.description: Home: the tab of app windows to record (not the operating system).

tab.area.description: Home: the tab for recording a part of a screen.

sources.refresh.description: Home: accessible name of the button that lists the screens and windows again.

sources.noWindows.description: Home: no app window to record.

region.size.description: Home: Area tab: the size of the area picked, in pixels.

region.change.description: Home: Area tab: picks the area again.

unfinished.title.description: Home: the heading of recordings that did not finish (their footage was kept).

unfinished.interrupted.description: Home: an unfinished recording stopped before it ended (Flown closed or the PC turned off).

unfinished.failed.description: Home: an unfinished recording whose processing failed.

unfinished.recoverTitle.description: Home: tooltip of Recover and Retry.

unfinished.recover.description: Home: turns an interrupted recording into a project.

unfinished.retry.description: Home: processes a failed recording again.

library.title.description: Home: the heading of the list of projects.

library.empty.description: Home: there are no projects yet.

library.emptyHint.description: Home: under "Your recordings will show up here." "Start recording" names the button.

library.deleteQuestion.description: Home: the question before a project is deleted; {name} is the project’s name.

record.title.description: Home: the heading of the recording panel.

record.audioCamera.description: Home: accessible name of the group of sound and camera choices.

record.microphone.description: Home: the microphone menu’s label; also a microphone with no name.

record.micLevel.description: Home: tooltip of the microphone’s level meter.

record.micDisconnected.description: Home: the microphone picked is not connected.

record.cameraDisconnected.description: Home: the camera picked is not connected.

record.windowsOnly.description: Home: tooltip of System audio on other systems.

record.systemAudio.description: Home: records the sound the PC plays.

record.keysTitle.description: Home: tooltip of Record keyboard activity. "Ctrl + C" is a keycap.

record.keys.description: Home: the switch that records shortcuts and when typing happens.

record.frameRate.description: Home: the label of the frame rate choice (30 or 60 fps).

record.fps.description: Home: a frame rate choice; fps is never translated.

record.selectArea.description: Home: the Start recording button on the Area tab before an area is picked.

record.stopHintKeys.description: Home: how to stop a recording; {keys} is the stop hotkey, shown as keycaps (Ctrl Shift 2), never translated.

record.stopHint.description: Home: how to stop a recording when no stop hotkey is set.

finishLater.description: Home: stops processing a recording; it stays under Unfinished recordings.

cameraBubble.drag.description: The camera bubble shown on the screen while recording: tooltip.

cameraBubble.live.description: The camera bubble: accessible name of the live camera picture.

cameraBubble.waiting.description: The camera bubble: shown until the camera’s picture arrives.

cameraBubble.toolbar.description: The camera bubble: accessible name of its buttons.

cameraBubble.sizeSmall.description: The camera bubble: accessible name of the small size button.

cameraBubble.sizeMedium.description: The camera bubble: accessible name of the medium size button.

cameraBubble.sizeLarge.description: The camera bubble: accessible name of the large size button.

cameraBubble.small.description: The camera bubble: tooltip of the S size button.

cameraBubble.medium.description: The camera bubble: tooltip of the M size button.

cameraBubble.large.description: The camera bubble: tooltip of the L size button.

cameraBubble.hide.description: The camera bubble: accessible name of its hide button.

cameraBubble.hideTitle.description: The camera bubble: tooltip of its hide button.

regionPicker.drag.description: The area picker over the screen: what to do.

regionPicker.keys.description: The area picker: the keys that confirm and cancel. Enter and Esc are keycaps, never translated.

regionPicker.record.description: The area picker: confirms the area.
